subject: Parking Violation Notice - $violation_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

You have received a parking violation notice for the following infraction:

Violation ID: $violation_id
Violation Type: $violation_type
Vehicle: $license_plate
Location: $location
Date & Time: $violation_date
Fine Amount: £$fine_amount
Payment Status: $payment_status

You must take action on this violation within 14 days to avoid additional penalties.

Next Steps:
1. Pay the fine online through the Student Finance Portal
2. Submit an appeal if you believe this violation was issued in error
3. Contact Parking Services at parking@university.edu for questions

Failure to respond to this violation may result in:
- Additional late fees
- Hold placed on your student account
- Vehicle registration suspension
- Towing of vehicle

To pay or appeal this violation, please visit:
https://university.edu/parking/violations

Thank you for your cooperation.

$signature
